newsitem.title: CHINA: Jingwei Textile '96 net seen 92 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Jingwei Textile '96 net seen 92 mln yuan.

text.p: China's Jingwei Textile Machinery Co Ltd is expected to report about 92 million yuan ($11 million) in after-tax profits for last year, the Economic Daily said on Thursday.
The newspaper did not say whether this was based on domestic or international accounting standards.
Pre-tax profits are estimated at 120 million yuan on sales of 610 million yuan in 1996, the newspaper said.
The company, a maker of production equipment for the textile industry, reported pre-tax profits of 88.74 million yuan on sales of 717.2 million for 1995 based on international accounting standards.
Jingwei is expected to report its 1996 results on April 14, an official said by telephone from company headquarters in northern Shanxi province.
Jingwei raised a total of 330 million yuan from its issuance of local currency A shares and H shares in Hong Kong last year.
Total assets of the company rose to 1.15 billion yuan at the end of 1996 from 740 million yuan at the start of the year, the newspaper said.

Net assets stood at 720 million yuan at end-1996, up from 320 million yuan at the beginning of the year, the newspaper said. The company's debt-to-asset ratio fell to 37.28 percent from 56.25 percent.

Jingwei encountered dificult market conditions last year due to competition from foreign machinery producers and a sluggish market for its main customers, domestic textile manufacturers, the newspaper said.
